purpose: Deterministic analytical oracle for simple-span beam deflection, maximum bending moment, extreme-fiber stress and support reactions. Not a building design or proof of code compliance.

model.idealization: Prismatic Euler-Bernoulli beam simply supported at both ends with no overhang.
assumptions: no self-weight unless explicitly included in a load case
no buckling, lateral-torsional instability, connections, fire, fatigue, or material defects

interpretation.pass_means: The declared elementary simply-supported beam formulas, geometry consistency and units/calculation plumbing match the synthetic reference within the stated tolerance.
does_not_mean: A finite-element solver has been independently validated.
The beam or a real building member is adequate or code-compliant.
Shear deformation, buckling, lateral-torsional instability, connections, load combinations, fire, fatigue or material variability have been checked.
